title: YESUKE [Album]
description: YESUKE is a fake name for the 2023 solo album that started as just speculation before being accepted as a real name without any actual evidence. The rumor started when GoodAssSub moderator u/P0PE_F0X was in contact with a supposed "CHANGE Insider" (another fake era), who sent cryptic messages including a photo of a statue of the black samurai Yasuke with no context during August 2023. P0PE_F0X later made an edit of this photo with Ye's face replacing Yasuke's with the caption YESUKE and posted it as fan art. Somehow, this spread across social media and suddenly people were referring to the next Kanye album as Yesuke as if it were confirmed and not just concept art based on false info. The rumor got so big Ye's collaborators have referenced it including Sean Leon.
